{
  "title": "Scholarship Dashboard",
  "subtitle": "Overview of scholarship status, marks, income, and geographic distribution",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total applicants",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Approved applications",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE \"Status\" = 'Approved'",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Average marks",
      "sql": "SELECT AVG(\"Marks %\") AS n FROM scholarship_applicants",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Average family income",
      "sql": "SELECT AVG(\"Family Income\") AS n FROM scholarship_applicants",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p5",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Applicants by status",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Status\" AS \"status\", COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC",
      "x": "status",
      "y": ["n"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p6",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Applicants by category",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Category\" AS \"category\", COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC",
      "x": "category",
      "y": ["n"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p7",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Applicants by taluka",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Taluka\" AS \"taluka\", COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC",
      "x": "taluka",
      "y": ["n"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p8",
      "kind": "line",
      "title": "Monthly trend of applications",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Sr No\" AS \"month\", COUNT(*) AS total FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1",
      "x": "month",
      "y": ["total"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p9",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "Top 10 applicants by marks",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Naam\" AS \"name\", \"Marks %\" AS \"marks\", \"Family Income\" AS \"income\", \"Status\" AS \"status\" FROM scholarship_applicants ORDER BY \"Marks %\" DESC LIMIT 10"
    }
  ],
  "narrative": "The dashboard provides a quick snapshot of the scholarship program's reach and performance. The total number of applicants and the count of approved applications give a clear sense of participation and approval rates. Average marks and average family income help gauge the academic standing and economic background of the cohort. Bar charts break down the distribution across status, category, and taluka, highlighting where resources are concentrated and where outreach may be needed. Finally, the monthly trend line shows how applications are evolving over time, while the top‑10 table spotlights the highest‑scoring candidates for further recognition."
}
